title: Ceiling on the Standing Monthly Transfer by Recent Money Out
content:
The standing transfer ceiling applied to an account of Savings & Money Market Accounts follows how much money has recently left the account: the total of withdrawals posted to it in the one calendar month ending on the instruction date.

- At least 2000.00 USD of withdrawals posted in that window: the standing transfer ceiling is 900.00 USD.
- At least 800.00 USD but less than 2000.00 USD of withdrawals posted in that window: the standing transfer ceiling is 500.00 USD.
- Less than 800.00 USD of withdrawals posted in that window: the standing transfer ceiling is 250.00 USD.

### Effect on a hypothetical instalment

Take an instalment of 640.00 USD. Where 2500.00 USD of withdrawals posted in the window, the ceiling of 900.00 USD does not bite and 640.00 USD stands. Where 1200.00 USD posted, the ceiling of 500.00 USD bites and the amount is held at 500.00 USD. Where 300.00 USD posted, the ceiling of 250.00 USD bites and the amount is held at 250.00 USD.

### Boundary of the figures

Withdrawals of exactly 2000.00 USD in the window give the 900.00 USD ceiling; 1999.99 USD gives 500.00 USD. Withdrawals of exactly 800.00 USD give 500.00 USD; 799.99 USD gives 250.00 USD.
